item.gojolander.blindfold.tooltip.0: Worn over the eyes, in place of a helmet. Its owner sees through it, and through walls.
item.gojolander.blindfold.tooltip.1: Its owner casts his ult with it on: Domain Expansion, Unlimited Void.
item.gojolander.blindfold.tooltip.2: On anyone else, a strip of black cloth.
message.gojolander.not_yours: It is only a strip of black cloth.
message.gojolander.domain.gap: There is no world here to close a Domain over.
message.gojolander.domain.cooldown: Unlimited Void is ready again in %s.
commands.gojolander.owner.none: The blindfold is nobody's yet, so anyone can craft it and cast with it. /gojolander owner <name> makes it someone's alone.
gamerule.unlimitedVoidRadius.description: How far the Domain reaches from where it is cast, in blocks.
gamerule.unlimitedVoidHoldSeconds.descri: How long the void holds whoever it caught, until the barrier shatters.
gamerule.unlimitedVoidCooldownSeconds.de: How long after casting it before it can be cast again.
advancements.gojolander.root.title: Throughout Heaven and Earth
advancements.gojolander.domain.title: Domain Expansion
advancements.gojolander.caught.title: Everything, All at Once
advancements.gojolander.caught.descripti: Catch another player in Unlimited Void
advancements.gojolander.crowd.title: The Honored One
advancements.gojolander.crowd.descriptio: Catch ten at once in Unlimited Void
gamerule.unlimitedVoidBreaks.description: Whether it takes whoever it holds down, a step at a time, to half a heart at its end.
gamerule.sixEyesRange.description: How far the blindfold's owner sees the living through walls, in blocks. 0 turns it off.
death.attack.gojolander.unlimited_void: %1$s's mind gave out in Unlimited Void
message.gojolander.purple.gap: There is nothing here to erase.

gamerule.hollowPurpleRange.description: How far Hollow Purple flies from where it is released, in blocks.
gamerule.hollowPurpleRadius.description: The radius of the tunnel it erases, in blocks.

gamerule.hollowPurpleCooldownSeconds.des: How long after casting it before it can be cast again.
